items.title: CodaLauncher is now available for Windows, Linux and macOS
items.text: Download the new launcher and play on Windows (x64), Linux (x64/ARM64), or macOS (Intel/Apple Silicon). The Mac build isn't Apple-notarized yet — you'll need to approve it in System Settings → Privacy & Security on first run.

items.title: HW Essentials adds saved homes and /back — installed automatically
items.text: Set homes with /sethome, list them with /homes, teleport with /home, and use /back to return to your last location. Ten home slots by default (configurable 1–100). Homes are saved per world and persist across sessions. Click Play in CodaLauncher — the mod installs itself.

items.title: Packs and menu scenes
items.text: CodaLauncher now includes Packs and Resourcepacks (CML Base and CML Base Resources required). CodaLoader adds classic and experimental Banner Sweep menu scenes that rotate randomly on each title screen visit.

items.title: CodaLauncher begins
items.text: A dedicated Howling Whispers launcher is taking shape — news, updates, mods, profiles, settings and logs in one Coda-flavored home.
